answer: A counterparty-diversity threshold blocks bulk fakes: a newcomer must trade with 20 distinct partners to earn rewards, and no partner may supply over 10% of its volume. A zephyr of deals proves nothing; each voyage is checked, and the kernel is the spread, not one sponsor. Faking 1,000 identities needs 20,000 relationships at 50 units each (1,000,000 units), and shared clusters are flagged. An honest agent pays once, keeping undiluted rewards.
